subject: corner column of a house wall of rough stone, on its own: one metre tall, half a metre square, of three or four large roughly dressed cornerstones laid one on another, each turned the other way to the one below, with smaller stones packed beside them, seen at a three-quarter view; its top and bottom cut flat and square so columns stack; the same rough grey fieldstone, ochre staining, lichen and pale lime mortar as the reference wall, its stones irregular and rough-faced, never neat bricks, the mortar recessed a little between them
